provenance: Coverage-guided locally authored calibration corpus; disjoint from all retained evaluation splits.
calibration: A compiler lowers a graph only after its tensor contracts are frozen.
Every conversion should report clipping, settling, and unsupported values.
The residual stream carries information between attention and feed-forward blocks.
A safe runtime can compare predicted cost with measured device behavior.
Calibration examples should span short prompts, long clauses, and punctuation.
Separate requests require a fresh state even when the same model is reused.
A profile range is a contract around observed values, not a guarantee of yield.
Fallback decisions belong in the execution trace beside the selected operation.
Quantization error may accumulate after several individually acceptable layers.
A held-out test must remain untouched while a transfer correction is fitted.
The final report should link model outputs to source, profile, and runtime hashes.
Energy accounting is incomplete when memory movement and conversion overhead are omitted.
claim_boundary: Local coverage-guided calibration fixture only; no physical analog qualification, hardware latency, energy, yield, or authorization claim.
